column1: # Accepted broken doc references — read by scripts/check_repo.py via
# check_references.py --baseline, so CI fails on NEW breakage only.
# Format: kind<TAB>doc<TAB>detail   (no line number — an accepted row must not
# come back as new when someone adds a paragraph above it)
# Every entry needs a reason. A row here is a judgment that the checker is
# wrong about this specific reference, not a to-do list — if a row is real
# drift, fix it instead of listing it. Entries that stop matching anything are
# reported as stale on every run and should be deleted.
# This repo's structural false-positive class: most docs here describe a
# DIFFERENT repo (a skill documenting its target) or use skill-relative
# shorthand. Neither is drift. See my_loops/docs-loop/SKILL.md, Limitations.
# A worked example in a format spec, naming another skill's reference file to
# show what a finding row looks like. Not a claim about skill-retro's own tree.
inline-path
